stage: P6 CIFAR-stem ResNet-18 source-to-target backbone transfer
research_question: RQ3: does the simplified shared early-exit method transfer beyond MobileNetV2?
scope: Development-only training and policy selection/transfer. No CIFAR official test access is authorized.

architecture_profile.selection_note: Positions 2 and 6 are the nearest legal completed-block boundaries. Their measured fractions are approximately 38.08% and 86.41%; no boundary lies inside the nominal target bands.

policy_selection.shared_within: backbone and dataset across source seeds
policy_selection.feasibility: Every source seed must satisfy the dataset-specific overall, balanced, and worst-class budgets, the early-fraction interval, and minimum MAC saving.
policy_selection.selection_objective: Among feasible shared thresholds, maximize minimum source-seed MAC saving, then mean source-seed MAC saving, then choose the higher threshold as the deterministic tie-break.

gates.if_source_fails: stop_without_target_training; retain all source seeds and negative results
gates.if_source_passes: freeze thresholds and source hashes before target training
gates.if_target_fails: stop_without_test; no threshold, exit, split, or seed changes
gates.if_target_passes: a separate one-time test evaluator still requires explicit user authorization

forbidden: No official CIFAR test iteration during source or target training/analysis.
No threshold selection on target seeds 74-76.
No pretrained weights or architecture changes after this freeze.
No reuse of MobileNetV2 thresholds 0.984 or 0.903 as ResNet-18 locked thresholds.
No deletion, replacement, or hidden rerun of an unfavorable seed.
